Name: Parrot Trinket into Raven
Author: PashaWithHat
Description:
Do you love the idea of the Parrot Egg combat trinket, but find that the brightly-colored tropical parrot isn't the best fit for your vibe? This retextures the parrot sprite into a raven for all your witchy Stardew needs.

It also changes the relevant text to "Raven's Egg" and "raven companion" instead of "Parrot Egg" and "parrot companion" for consistency. It does NOT change the graphic for the actual egg, so it's fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21161]Letteas Combat Trinkets Retexture[/url]! 

* Disclaimer: the screenshot of Elliot is not actually what he says. His real dialogue is "Be careful you don't accidentally take a raven's egg. They'll hold a grudge against you for the rest of their days!" but since these are raven's eggs now I thought it'd be funny to alter the screenshot. The mod does not change his dialogue (...yet?).
